scripts.check: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test
scripts.lint: pnpm --recursive --if-present run lint && pnpm exec web/node_modules/.bin/eslint --config web/eslint.config.mjs tests/web
scripts.docs:build: pnpm run docs:prepare && uv run --project docs-site zensical build --clean --strict --config-file docs-site/mkdocs.yml && node docs-site/install-output.mjs
scripts.web:build: pnpm --filter @polycolab/web run build && pnpm run docs:build
scripts.api:dev: AUTH_MODE=local uv --directory backend run sh -c 'python -m polycolab.bootstrap_admin && exec uvicorn polycolab.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000'
scripts.api:check: uv --directory backend run ruff format --check . ../tests/backend && uv --directory backend run ruff check . ../tests/backend && uv --directory backend run mypy polycolab ../tests/backend && uv --directory backend run pytest
scripts.api:migrate: uv --directory backend run alembic upgrade head
scripts.api:contract: uv --directory backend run python -m polycolab.export_openapi && pnpm --filter @polycolab/api-client run generate
scripts.api:contract:check: uv --directory backend run python -m polycolab.export_openapi --check && pnpm --filter @polycolab/api-client run generate:check
